why: The article gives Zhang Qian's missions mostly as regions and peoples (the Xiongnu lands, Dayuan, the Yuezhi, Daxia, Kangju, the Wusun) with no town or fort for most of them. Only Chang'an, Lop Nor, Bactra and Youbeiping are point-like places, and the order of the visits to Kangju and Dayuan is not given, so fewer than eight placed, ordered stops can be drawn without supplying the route from outside knowledge.
